Currently being maintained by Hav3rchuck, willus8888, Edavad42, and mdcooledge

- bug fixes

v22 - mdcooledge
- removed Formation Support max 1 contraint to allow for mulitple different selection
- added Berlin: German Command Cards and supporting logic

v23 - mdcooledge
- added Bagration: Axis-Alies data.


v25 - mdcooledge
-added Late-War Leviathans data.

sharedRules.name: Assault 5+
sharedRules.description: Teams with the Assault # special rule uses # number for To Hit rolls in Assaults rather than the normal one shown on the card.

sharedRules.name: Brutal
sharedRules.description: Intantry, Gun and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successful Saves.

sharedRules.name: Dedicated AA
sharedRules.description: Use full ROF when firing at Aircraft

sharedRules.name: Forward Firing
sharedRules.description: Weapons can only hit targets fully in front of the Team.

sharedRules.name: Gun Shield
sharedRules.description: A Gun Team with the Gun Shield is in Bulletproof Cover when Shot at from in front of the Team's base. A Gun Shield does not offer any protection against Artillery Bombardments or if the Team moved at Dash speed.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Weapon
sharedRules.description: A Heavy Weapon Team cannot Charge into Contact, but may be an Assaulting Team if in Contact with an enemy Team. Heavy Weapons have a worse Assault rating.

sharedRules.name: HQ Transport
sharedRules.description: Transports are part of the HQ Unit.

sharedRules.name: Independent
sharedRules.description: An Independent Team can use the Mistaken Target rule to reassign hits to nearby Units, but cannot Charge into Contact, nor take an Objective.

sharedRules.name: Large Gun
sharedRules.description: Cannot be placed from Ambush within 16"/40cm of the enemy.

sharedRules.name: No HE
sharedRules.description: A weapon with No HE targeting an Infantry or Gun Team, adds +1 to the score needed To Hit.

sharedRules.name: Observer
sharedRules.description: Team can Spot for any friendly Artillery Unit

sharedRules.name: Overworked
sharedRules.description: Overworked weapons add +1 to the scort To Hit when moving.

sharedRules.name: Pinned ROF 1
sharedRules.description: Reduce ROF to 1 when Pinned Down

sharedRules.name: Rear Firing
sharedRules.description: Weapons can only hit targets fully to the rear of the Team.

sharedRules.name: Scout
sharedRules.description: Scouts are Gone to Ground unless they Shoot or Assault. This means that if they are Concealed, the enemy will suffer an additional +1 penalty to hit them.

sharedRules.name: Self-Defence AA
sharedRules.description: Self-Defence AA weapons can Shoot at Aircraft with ROF 1.

sharedRules.name: Slow Firing
sharedRules.description: +1 To Hit for Moving ROF.

sharedRules.name: Smoke
sharedRules.description: Smoke weapons can Shoot Smoke ammunition.

sharedRules.name: Smoke Bombardment
sharedRules.description: Once per game can fire a Smoke Bombardment.

sharedRules.name: SP Gun
sharedRules.description: SP Guns have a worse Counterattack rating and a worse Assault rating. If they are Open-topped they have a significantly worse Counterattack rating.

sharedRules.name: Spearhead
sharedRules.description: Unit can move before the game to expand the Deployment Area.

sharedRules.name: Protected Ammo
sharedRules.description: Tanks with Protected Ammo have a better Remount rating.

sharedRules.name: Assault 4+
sharedRules.description: Teams with the Assault # special rule uses # number for To Hit rolls in Assaults rather than the normal one shown on the card.

sharedRules.name: Passengers #
sharedRules.comment: These have all been given the same name and text so as to not break links in the 20+ catalogs where they are present; please do not alter them in any way. - Ursy
sharedRules.description: A Transport Team can carry Infantry Teams as Passengers. The # indicatres how many Teams can be carried.

sharedRules.name: Transport Attachment
sharedRules.description: Infantry and Gun Units containing Transport Teams as a Tank Attachment (or vice versa) are split into two Units; an Infantry or Gun Unit and a Transport Unit (each with their Unit Leader). Both parts of the Unit operate independently as seperate Units, supporting each other, although they deploy as a single Unit.

sharedRules.name: Gun
sharedRules.description: Gun Teams has a worse Assault rating.

sharedRules.name: Bombs
sharedRules.description: No penalty for having only 1 or 2 weapons firing, Only Teams from this Unit can Spot for it.

sharedRules.name: Overhead Fire
sharedRules.description: Grenade launchers and light mortars capable of Overhead Fire can fire over friendly teams.

sharedRules.name: Secondary Weapon
sharedRules.description: Weapons with this rule my fire at the same or a different target at the same time as another weapon at ROT 1 and +1 To Hit.

sharedRules.name: Passengers #
sharedRules.comment: These have all been given the same name and text so as to not break links in the 20+ catalogs where they are present; please do not alter them in any way. - Ursy
sharedRules.description: A Transport Team can carry Infantry Teams as Passengers. The # indicatres how many Teams can be carried.

sharedRules.name: Passengers #
sharedRules.comment: These have all been given the same name and text so as to not break links in the 20+ catalogs where they are present; please do not alter them in any way. - Ursy
sharedRules.description: A Transport Team can carry Infantry Teams as Passengers. The # indicatres how many Teams can be carried.

sharedRules.name: Assault 6+
sharedRules.description: Teams with the Assault # special rule uses # number for To Hit rolls in Assaults rather than the normal one shown on the card.

sharedRules.name: Assault 3+
sharedRules.description: Teams with the Assault # special rule uses # number for To Hit rolls in Assaults rather than the normal one shown on the card.

sharedRules.name: Pinned ROF 2
sharedRules.description: Reduce ROF to 2 when Pinned Down

sharedRules.name: Rockets
sharedRules.description: No penalty for having only 1 or 2 weapons firing, Only Teams from this Unit can Spot for it.

sharedRules.name: Tractor
sharedRules.description: Team can carry one Gun Team as Passangers.

sharedRules.name: Salvo
sharedRules.description:
Weapons with a ROF of "salvo" are Artillery weapons and fire Artillery Bombardments, but use a 10”/25cm square Salvo Template rather than the normal 6”/15cm Artillery Template.

A Salvo Template may not be placed within 6"/15cm of a friendly Team.

sharedRules.name: Flame-thrower
sharedRules.description:
Infantry, Gun, and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successful Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower and the Unit is automatically Pinned Down. Armoured Tank Teams use their Top armour for Armour Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower.
Flame-throwers may shoot in Defensive Fire. However, while a Unit that is Hit by a Flame-thrower is Pinned Down, this does not automatically stop the assault. The defender still needs to score five (or eight) hits as normal to stop the assault as normal.

sharedRules.name: Passengers #
sharedRules.comment: These have all been given the same name and text so as to not break links in the 20+ catalogs where they are present; please do not alter them in any way. - Ursy
sharedRules.description: A Transport Team can carry Infantry Teams as Passengers. The # indicatres how many Teams can be carried.

sharedRules.name: Amphibious
sharedRules.description: This vehicle treats impassable water as Difficult Terrain

sharedRules.name: Softskin
sharedRules.description: If transport destroyed, passengers ddestroyed.  the rest are sent to the rear and passengers must dismount.

sharedRules.name: Unarmoured
sharedRules.description: Team cannot Charge into Contact and must Break Off if Assaulted.

sharedRules.name: One-man Turret
sharedRules.description:
Some tanks and armoured cars have tiny one-man turrets, leaving one man the job of commander, gunner, and loader.

A One-man Turret main weapon adds +1 to the score needed To Hit when moving.

sharedRules.name: Cavalry
sharedRules.description: +1 To Hit for all Shooting. Move 6"/15cm when Charging into Contact. Cannot hit Armoured Tanks in Assaults. Not Concealed and friends cannot shoot over these teams when Stationary in Open. Cannot occupy Foxholes or Buildings.

sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: Target Armour is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away.

sharedRules.name: Pioneers
sharedRules.description: Teams cross Minefields on 3+. If not Pinned Down, may clear the Minefield automatically next turn.

sharedRules.name: Armoured Reserve
sharedRules.description: In missions with Deep Reserves, you may only field one Tank Unit with Armoured Reserve, one Tank Unit with Front Armour of 3 or more, or one Aircraft Unit on the table at the start of the game.

sharedRules.name: Dismount
sharedRules.description: Unit may dismount at the start of the Movement Step. Once dismounted, may not remount for rest of the game and moves as Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Gigantic
sharedRules.description: Teams for this Unit cannot be placed from Ambush within 16"/40cm of any enemy Team.

sharedRules.name: Mountaineers
sharedRules.description: Teams frim a Unit with Mountaineers that start their Movement Step adjacent to a cliff or mountain side (or another similar Impassable terrain feature) roll a Skill Test. If successful, the Team may move using Terrain Dash across the terrain.

sharedRules.name: Accurate
sharedRules.description: Accurate weapons do not suffer the usual +1 to hit penalty if the targeted Team is more than 16”/40cm away and the Shooting Team did not Move.

sharedRules.name: Air Observation Post
sharedRules.description:
An Air Observation Post is an Aircraft that arrives on a roll of 3+ (rather than the usual 4+)

An Air Observation Post is unarmed, but can act as an Observer, Spotting for an Artillery Bombardment with an Aiming Point within 12"/30cm of tha Aircraft. The opposing player may shoot at the Aircraft immediately before it rolls to Range In as though the aircraft was Shooting.

sharedRules.name: Back-blast
sharedRules.description: A Team firing a Back-blast weapon cannot be Concealed if it shot in its previous Shooting Step.

sharedRules.name: Component
sharedRules.description: Component Teams rule use the same rating of their parent Unit.

sharedRules.name: Infra-Red (IR)
sharedRules.description: A Unit with Infra-Red rolls two dice on the Night Visibility Table and chooses the highest score.

sharedRules.name: MG Transport
sharedRules.description: M1917 HMG or M1919 LMG teams my fire while Monunted as a Passenger in an M3 half-track, using the Optional Passenger MG weapon line.

sharedRules.name: Seek, Strike, and Destroy
sharedRules.description: A Unit with Seek, Strike, and Destroy my attempt a Shoot and Scoot Movement Order after succeeding with a Blitz Move Movment Order earlier in the same turn.

sharedRules.name: Smooth RIde
sharedRules.description: M4 Easy Eight Tank teams do not suffer the +1 penalty To Hit for Stabiliser if they Move less than 4"/10cm in the Movement Step.

sharedRules.name: Stabiliser
sharedRules.description: Weapons with Stabiliser suffer a +1 penalty To Hit if the Tank Moved in the Movement Step.

sharedRules.name: Time on Target
sharedRules.description: If an Artillery Unit with Time on Targer ranges in on the first attempt, any Infantry or Gun Teams hit by the Bombardment must re-roll successful Saves.

sharedRules.name: Mounted Assault
sharedRules.description: This Unit has better Assault & Counterattack ratings with Passengers (present in columns)

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear.

sharedRules.name: Guided
sharedRules.description: Guided weapons do not suffer the usual +1 penalty TO Hit if the targeted Team is more than 16"/40cm away. Guided weapons cannot hit Infantry Teams unless the Infantry are stationary and in Bulletproof Cover.

sharedRules.name: Stormtroopers
sharedRules.description: The Unit may attempt a second Movement Order after succeeding in its first Movement Order. The second Movement Order must be different from the first.

sharedRules.name: Old Hand
sharedRules.description: An Old Hand Formation Commander gives Units from their Formation whose Unit Leader is within 6"/15cm of the Formation Commander a Tactics raiting of 3+.

sharedRules.name: IR Searchlight
sharedRules.description: A Unit with an Infra-Red Searchlight may, instead of Shooting, Illuminate a target in Line of Sight within 32"/80cm. To do this the unit with the Infra-Red Searchlight does not need to roll for Night Visibility and can automatically see out to 32"/80cm. All Units with the Infra-Red special rule may Shoot at that target without rolling for Night Visibility. Hits may be allocated to Teams from the same Unit within 6"/15cm of the target Team.

sharedRules.name: Night Fighters
sharedRules.description:
If a Force with Night Fighters is the Attacker in a mission without the Meeting Engagement rule, the player may attack at night. If they do so, Night Fighting Dawn rules are in effect at the start of the game.

Units from Formations with Night Fighters can move freely from the start of the game. Other Units from other Formations or Support in the Force, unless equipped with Infra-Red, may not move out of their Deployment Area while the game is played in Darkness, but can move when Dawn breaks.

sharedRules.name: Uhu
sharedRules.description:
An Sd Kfz 251/Uhu Tank Team is sent to the rear at the beginning of their Movement Step in which the game is fought in Daylight. An Uhu removed n this fashion does not count as Destroyed, and if Bailed Out, automatically Remounts.

An Uhu Tank Team is brought forward at the beginning of their first Movement Step in which the game is fought at Night. Before moving an Infra-Red equipped Unit, you may place its Uhu on the table.

The Uhu must be placed with 4"/10cm of a Team from the Unit, and may not be:
* within 16"/40cm of any enemy Team within Line of Sight, unless Concealed by Terrain from it, or
* within 4"/10cm of any enemy Team.

Once Brought Forward in this way, the Uhu must move at Dash Speed (and therefore cannot Shoot or Assault this turn), but may Illuminate a target with its Infra-Red Searchlights.

sharedRules.name: Bazooka Skirts
sharedRules.description: A Tank Team with Bazooka Skirts increases its Side armour to 5 against weapons with Firepower 5+ or 6.

sharedRules.name: Nest
sharedRules.description:
A Nest is always Concealed and in Bulletproof Cover. Teams Shooting a Nest must re-roll successful Firepower tests to Destroy it.
Nests cannot be Assaulted by Tanks nor can they Charge into Contact.
Each Nest is a separate Unit, even when taken as part of the same selection.

sharedRules.comment: These have all been given the same name and text so as to not break links in the 20+ catalogs where they are present; please do not alter them in any way. - Ursy
sharedRules.description: A Transport Team can carry Infantry Teams as Passengers. The # indicatres how many Teams can be carried.

sharedSelectionEntries.comment: This is included into warrior upgrades so that there are no other warriors added to the force
